entities.summary:
The COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia was a viral outbreak that took place in the country from 2020-01-27. 

This event was significant because it was one of the earliest recorded cases of the pandemic in Southeast Asia, with the first reported case occurring on 2020-01-27. The outbreak was contained fairly quickly, with the government implementing strict measures to control the spread of the virus. 

The pandemic had a significant impact on the country's economy, with the tourism industry being particularly hard hit. The government also had to implement measures to support the healthcare system, which was put under significant pressure due to the influx of patients. 

The pandemic had a lasting legacy in Cambodia, with the government implementing new measures to improve the country's preparedness for future outbreaks. The event also highlighted the importance of international cooperation in responding to global health crises. 

In the words of a senior health official, 'The COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia was a wake-up call for the country, and we have learned valuable lessons that will help us prepare for future outbreaks.'
